source: Takanishi et al. 1985, Fig. 12 (computed CoM and ZMP in single support, right sole), digitized from the 600 dpi scan
frame: mm relative to the centre of the 'stable region of right sole' rectangle (taken as the 140 x 280 mm sole; ankle assumed at its centre); x forward, 'inboard' toward the other foot
orientation_note: forward = up in the figure. Inferred, not labelled: CoM markers are evenly spaced in time and dense at one end; Fig. 8 shows the change-over ending slow and starting fast, so the dense end is the start of single support.

com_end.speed_m_s: about 0.45 if markers are 25 ms apart (40 intervals in 1.0 s; marker count not exact)
